advice.en: No registered company: open as an individual. Creem, Dodo Payments and Waffo Pancake take individuals in mainland China, and Paddle accepts individuals and sole traders anywhere outside its sanctions list.
advice.zh: 没注册公司，就用个人开。Creem、Dodo Payments、Waffo Pancake 都接受中国大陆个人，Paddle 也接受个人和个体经营（制裁名单以外的国家都行）。

advice.en: Dodo's line between the two: an individual is a creator or sole proprietor paid personally, with no company registration or business tax ID; a registered entity has a tax ID and is paid to the company's bank account.
advice.zh: Dodo 给的分法：个人是创作者或个体经营，钱进你本人的账户，没有公司注册和税号；注册实体有税号，钱进公司的对公账户。

advice.en: Creem pays a mainland individual to Alipay: up to CNY 50,000 a payout and CNY 300,000–600,000 a year. Past that, a company's bank account.
advice.zh: Creem 给大陆个人打款到支付宝：单笔最多 5 万元，每年 30–60 万元。超过这个量，要用公司的对公账户。

advice.en: Stripe opens for neither individuals nor companies in mainland China: a Hong Kong individual account needs a Hong Kong ID number and a US one an SSN or ITIN, so a mainland founder opens with a Hong Kong or US company. Polar pays out only through Stripe, so the same holds.
advice.zh: Stripe 不给中国大陆个人或公司开户：香港个人户要香港身份证号，美国个人户要 SSN 或 ITIN，所以大陆创业者要用香港或美国公司开；Polar 只能通过 Stripe 出款，也一样。

advice.en: A company on Waffo Pancake is still paid as a person for now: company payout accounts are 'being finalized', so payouts go to the verified individual.
advice.zh: 在 Waffo Pancake 用公司开户，目前还是按个人收款：公司收款账户「正在完善」，钱打到验证过身份的个人。

advice.en: Switching later from individual to company means a business verification and a new bank check (Dodo), so pick the one you will keep.
advice.zh: 以后从个人改成公司，要补公司验证、重新验证银行账户（Dodo 如此），所以按你打算长期用的身份选。

advice.en: How the income is taxed at home is a question for an accountant: this guide covers what the platforms ask for, not tax.
advice.zh: 收入在国内怎么报税，请问会计：这里只写平台的要求，不涉及税务。

steps.en: Fill in the business details: your full name as an individual, or the company's name.
steps.zh: 填业务信息：个人填本人全名，公司填公司名。

steps.en: Verify your identity (KYC).
steps.zh: 做身份验证（KYC）。

steps.en: Verify your identity (KYC) and the company (KYB).
steps.zh: 做身份验证（KYC）和公司验证（KYB）。

steps.en: Add a payout account: Alipay for a mainland individual.
steps.zh: 添加收款账户：大陆个人用支付宝。

steps.en: Add a payout account: the company's bank account.
steps.zh: 添加收款账户：公司的对公银行账户。

steps.en: Creem's team reviews the store and the website, in 1–2 working days. A rejection is final for that store and that business, so check the site first.
steps.zh: Creem 人工审核店铺和网站，1–2 个工作日。被拒是终局，这个店铺和这家公司都不能再申请，所以先体检网站。

steps.en: Live payments are turned on.
steps.zh: 开通正式收款。

individual.en: an identity document for KYC
individual.zh: 做 KYC 用的身份证件

individual.en: an Alipay account in your name
individual.zh: 本人名下的支付宝

individual.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
individual.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

company.en: the company's registration documents for KYB
company.zh: 做 KYB 用的公司注册文件

company.en: the company's bank account
company.zh: 公司的对公银行账户

company.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
company.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

steps.en: Choose the account type: Individual.
steps.zh: 选账户类型：个人（Individual）。

steps.en: Choose the account type: Registered Entity.
steps.zh: 选账户类型：注册实体（Registered Entity）。

steps.en: Submit the product information.
steps.zh: 提交产品信息。

steps.en: Verify your identity with a government-issued photo ID and a selfie, through Persona: a few minutes, three attempts.
steps.zh: 用政府签发的带照片证件和自拍做身份验证（Persona）：几分钟，有 3 次机会。

steps.en: Business verification (KYB): the company registration number with its certificate of incorporation, and IDs for every director and every owner of 10% or more.
steps.zh: 公司验证（KYB）：公司注册号和注册证书（或当地同等文件），以及每位董事和持股 10% 以上股东的证件。

steps.en: Add a bank account in the same name as the verified ID; third-party accounts are refused.
steps.zh: 填银行账户：户名必须和验证过的证件一致，不能用别人的账户。

steps.en: Add the company's bank account, in its legal name.
steps.zh: 填公司的银行账户，户名是公司全称。

steps.en: The review takes 1–3 business days, with one appeal; payouts start after a separate monitoring review.
steps.zh: 审核 1–3 个工作日，可以申诉一次；第一次出款前还有一轮单独的监控审核。

individual.en: a valid, physical photo ID issued by a country on Dodo's accepted list
individual.zh: Dodo 可接受国家签发的有效实体带照片证件

individual.en: a phone or webcam for the selfie
individual.zh: 能自拍的手机或摄像头

individual.en: a bank account in your own name
individual.zh: 本人名下的银行账户

individual.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
individual.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

company.en: the company registration number and certificate of incorporation (a tax ID is optional)
company.zh: 公司注册号和注册证书（税号可选）

company.en: IDs for every director and every owner of 10% or more
company.zh: 每位董事和持股 10% 以上股东的证件

company.en: a bank account in the company's legal name
company.zh: 公司名下的银行账户

company.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
company.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

steps.en: Sign up on the Pancake dashboard with Google, GitHub or a magic link; the first login creates a store. No company registration is needed.
steps.zh: 在 Pancake 后台用 Google、GitHub 或邮箱链接注册，第一次登录就建好店铺，不需要公司注册。

steps.en: Build and take test payments in test mode; that needs no review.
steps.zh: 先在测试模式里接好支付、跑测试付款，这一步不用审核。

steps.en: In Settings → Business Details, verify the support email (a 6-digit code) and the website's domain (a DNS TXT record, an HTML meta tag, a .well-known file or a matching email domain).
steps.zh: 在 Settings → Business Details 里验证支持邮箱（6 位验证码）和网站域名（DNS TXT 记录、HTML meta 标签、.well-known 文件或同域名邮箱，四选一）。

steps.en: Fill in the business details as Individual / Solo developer and submit: the review usually takes 1–3 business days, and the store switches to live payments by itself once approved.
steps.zh: 按「Individual / Solo developer」填业务信息并提交：审核通常 1–3 个工作日，通过后店铺自动切到正式收款。

steps.en: Fill in the business details as Registered business and submit: the review usually takes 1–3 business days, and the store switches to live payments by itself once approved.
steps.zh: 按「Registered business」填业务信息并提交：审核通常 1–3 个工作日，通过后店铺自动切到正式收款。

steps.en: Verify your identity on your profile: your legal name exactly as on the ID, and a mainland China national ID (a passport for other nationalities).
steps.zh: 在个人资料里做身份验证：姓名和证件上一字不差，中国大陆用居民身份证，其他国籍用护照。

steps.en: Add a payout account: a bank card or Alipay in mainland China (Alipay up to RMB 50,000 a payout and RMB 300,000 a year per recipient). Payouts are in US dollars, 1% (minimum US$10).
steps.zh: 添加收款账户：中国大陆可以用银行卡或支付宝（支付宝单笔最多 5 万元、每人每年 30 万元）。按美元出款，手续费 1%（最低 10 美元）。

steps.en: Company payout accounts are not live yet: payouts still go to the verified person's account, in mainland China, Hong Kong, the US, Japan, South Korea or Singapore.
steps.zh: 公司收款账户还没开放：目前出款仍然打到验证过身份的个人账户，地区限中国大陆、香港、美国、日本、韩国、新加坡。

steps.en: Each sale waits about 10 business days before it can be paid out; bank-card payouts requested before 15:00 Beijing time on a business day arrive the same day.
steps.zh: 每笔收入约 10 个工作日后才能提现；工作日北京时间 15:00 前申请的银行卡提现当天到账。

individual.en: a mainland China national ID, and your name exactly as on it
individual.zh: 中国大陆居民身份证，姓名和证件一致

individual.en: a bank card or Alipay in your own name
individual.zh: 本人名下的银行卡或支付宝

individual.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
individual.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

company.en: the company's legal name
company.zh: 公司全称

company.en: a person whose verified identity receives the payouts for now
company.zh: 目前由一位验证过身份的个人收款

company.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
company.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

steps.en: Sign up, and test in a separate sandbox account (the sandbox needs no domain approval).
steps.zh: 注册账号，另开一个沙盒账号测试（沙盒不用审域名）。

steps.en: Submit each checkout domain under My Account → Settings → Website approval. The site must be live on HTTPS and show the product, prices, features, terms, refund and privacy policies; the terms must name you (your legal name as a sole trader) or the company. Most domains pass automatically; a manual review takes 5–7 business days.
steps.zh: 在 My Account → Settings → Website approval 提交每个结账域名：网站要已上线、用 HTTPS，写清产品、价格、功能、服务条款、退款和隐私政策；条款里要写本人（个体经营写法定姓名）或公司名。大多数域名自动通过，人工审核 5–7 个工作日。

steps.en: Business verification from your sign-up details: registration documents if asked, and every owner of 25% or more (2–4 business days if manual). Individuals and sole traders skip this step.
steps.zh: 公司验证：按注册信息核对，可能要注册文件，以及持股 25% 以上的每位股东（人工审核 2–4 个工作日）。个人和个体经营跳过这一步。

steps.en: Identity verification through Sumsub: a government ID and proof of address if asked, sometimes a short selfie video. It is usually instant.
steps.zh: 通过 Sumsub 做身份验证：可能要政府签发的证件和地址证明，有时还要一段自拍视频，通常即时完成。

steps.en: Add payout details: bank transfer or Payoneer. CNY is paid by bank wire; a cross-currency SWIFT payout costs US$15.
steps.zh: 填出款信息：银行转账或 Payoneer。可以按人民币电汇，跨币种 SWIFT 每笔 15 美元。

steps.en: Payouts are monthly: the balance above your threshold (minimum US$100) becomes a payout on the 1st and is sent by the 15th.
steps.zh: 每月出款一次：超过门槛（最低 100 美元）的余额在 1 号生成付款，15 号前打出。

individual.en: a government ID, and proof of address if asked
individual.zh: 政府签发的证件，可能还要地址证明

individual.en: terms of service that name you
individual.zh: 写着本人名字的服务条款

individual.en: a live HTTPS website with prices, terms, refund and privacy policies
individual.zh: 已上线的 HTTPS 网站，有价格、条款、退款和隐私政策

company.en: registration documents, and the owners of 25% or more
company.zh: 公司注册文件，以及持股 25% 以上的股东

company.en: an ID check of at least one owner
company.zh: 至少一位股东的身份验证

company.en: a live HTTPS website with prices, terms, refund and privacy policies
company.zh: 已上线的 HTTPS 网站，有价格、条款、退款和隐私政策

steps.en: A new store starts in test mode.
steps.zh: 新店铺默认是测试模式。

steps.en: Click Activate your store: a short questionnaire about the business and its customers, then identity verification (personal details and a photo of a government ID).
steps.zh: 点「Activate your store」：先填一份关于业务和客户的问卷，再做身份验证（个人信息加政府签发证件的照片）。

steps.en: KYC and KYB review, usually 2–3 business days.
steps.zh: KYC 和 KYB 审核，通常 2–3 个工作日。

steps.en: Copy the test products to live mode.
steps.zh: 把测试模式里的产品复制到正式模式。

steps.en: Set up payouts: a bank account in a supported country, or a verified PayPal account. Mainland China is paid only through PayPal (3% a payout, capped at US$30, outside the US).
steps.zh: 设置出款：受支持国家的银行账户，或者验证过的 PayPal。中国大陆只能走 PayPal（美国以外每笔 3%，最高 30 美元）。

steps.en: Submit Form W-8 (outside the US) or W-9 (US); payouts can stay off until you do.
steps.zh: 提交 W-8（美国以外）或 W-9（美国）税表；不交可能一直不能出款。

steps.en: Payouts on the 1st and 15th; sales are held 13 days; minimum US$50.
steps.zh: 每月 1 号和 15 号出款；销售额先押 13 天；最低 50 美元。

individual.en: a photo of a government ID
individual.zh: 政府签发证件的照片

individual.en: a verified PayPal account (from mainland China)
individual.zh: 验证过的 PayPal 账户（中国大陆）

individual.en: Form W-8
individual.zh: W-8 税表

individual.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
individual.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

company.en: the company's details for KYB (documents not listed)
company.zh: 公司信息（KYB 要哪些文件官方没列）

company.en: a bank account in a supported country, or PayPal
company.zh: 受支持国家的银行账户，或 PayPal

company.en: Form W-8 or W-9
company.zh: W-8 或 W-9 税表

company.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
company.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

steps.en: Build the integration first: Polar's advice is to build before you submit.
steps.zh: 先把产品和支付接好：Polar 建议做完再提交审核。

steps.en: Finance → Account: submit for review (your business, products and how you will use Polar).
steps.zh: 在 Finance → Account 提交审核：业务、产品和打算怎么用 Polar。

steps.en: The organization owner verifies identity through Stripe Identity: a passport, ID card or driver's licence, and a selfie.
steps.zh: 组织所有人通过 Stripe Identity 验证身份：护照、身份证或驾照，加一张自拍。

steps.en: Connect a payout account through Stripe Connect Express: a bank account in the country you live in and its currency. Wise, Payoneer and Revolut usually fail Stripe's checks.
steps.zh: 通过 Stripe Connect Express 绑定收款账户：居住国家、本币的银行账户。Wise、Payoneer、Revolut 这类通常过不了 Stripe 的验证。

steps.en: Connect a payout account through Stripe Connect Express: a business bank account in the company's country and currency.
steps.zh: 通过 Stripe Connect Express 绑定收款账户：公司所在国家、本币的对公银行账户。

steps.en: The first review can take up to 14 days; reviewers may ask for a 100% discount code to try the product.
steps.zh: 首次审核最长 14 天；审核员可能要一个 100% 折扣码来试用产品。

steps.en: Withdraw by hand; new organizations have a 7-day settlement delay, and a payout takes 4–7 business days.
steps.zh: 手动提现；新组织有 7 天结算延迟，到账要 4–7 个工作日。

individual.en: a passport, ID card or driver's licence, and a selfie
individual.zh: 护照、身份证或驾照，加自拍

individual.en: a personal bank account in a country Polar pays out to
individual.zh: Polar 支持出款国家的个人银行账户

individual.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
individual.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

company.en: the owner's ID and a selfie
company.zh: 所有人的证件和自拍

company.en: a business bank account in the company's country and currency
company.zh: 公司所在国家、本币的对公银行账户

company.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
company.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

steps.en: Create an account; you can test in a sandbox straight away.
steps.zh: 注册账号，马上可以在沙盒里测试。

steps.en: Verify your business in the Dashboard: the business, the product, and your relationship to it. The business country cannot be changed after activation.
steps.zh: 在后台验证业务：业务信息、产品、你和公司的关系。激活后业务所在国家不能再改。

steps.en: Company details by country: Hong Kong, the Company or Business Registration Number; the US, an EIN, the person with significant control and every owner of 25% or more (a non-US representative gives a home-country tax ID); the UK, the directors and owners.
steps.zh: 按国家填公司信息：香港要公司注册号或商业登记号；美国要 EIN、一位有重大控制权的人和持股 25% 以上的每位股东（非美国的负责人提供本国税号）；英国要董事和股东。

steps.en: Add a bank account in the account's country; its currency must match the payout settings.
steps.zh: 添加开户国家的银行账户，币种要和出款设置一致。

steps.en: Work through the go-live checklist (two-step login, statement descriptor, bank details).
steps.zh: 做完上线清单（两步验证、账单描述、银行信息）。

steps.en: The first payout usually arrives 7–14 days after the first live payment.
steps.zh: 第一笔出款通常在第一笔正式收款后 7–14 天到账。

individual.en: a Hong Kong ID number (Hong Kong) or an SSN or ITIN (US): without one, open with a company
individual.zh: 香港身份证号（香港）或 SSN、ITIN（美国）：没有的话要用公司开

individual.en: a live website that meets the review checklist
individual.zh: 一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

company.en: the company registration number, or an EIN in the US
company.zh: 公司注册号，美国是 EIN

company.en: the representative's ID, and an address in that country (no PO box)
company.zh: 负责人证件，以及开户国家的地址（不能用信箱）

company.en: a bank account in the company's name in that country
company.zh: 开户国家、公司名下的银行账户

company.en: a public website that matches the product description
company.zh: 和产品描述一致的公开网站

steps.en: Fill in Payment Settings as Individual: you sell under your own name and have no registration documents.
steps.zh: 填付款设置，选「个人」：用本人名义卖、没有注册文件。

steps.en: Fill in Payment Settings as Business: the representative submits registration documents and personal ID.
steps.zh: 填付款设置，选「公司」：负责人提交注册文件和个人证件。

steps.en: Choose a payout method: a local bank account in a listed country, or PayPal where banks are not supported. Mainland China is paid only through PayPal, in US dollars, with a 2% fee; PayPal payouts need no ID upload.
steps.zh: 选出款方式：受支持国家的本地银行账户，不支持银行的地方用 PayPal。中国大陆只能走 PayPal，按美元，手续费 2%；PayPal 出款不用上传证件。

steps.en: After some time and sales, Stripe asks for more identity details (date of birth, ID number, a photo ID, proof of address).
steps.zh: 卖了一段时间后，Stripe 会要求补充身份信息（生日、证件号、证件照片、地址证明）。

steps.en: An account review comes before the first payout, usually after 3–4 real sales and over US$100; it takes 1–3 weeks. Buying your own product does not speed it up and can get you banned.
steps.zh: 第一笔出款前有一次账户审核，通常在 3–4 笔真实订单、超过 100 美元之后，需要 1–3 周。自己买自己的产品不会加快审核，还可能被封。

steps.en: Payouts weekly, monthly or quarterly; minimum US$100; a 7-day hold.
steps.zh: 按周、月或季度出款；最低 100 美元；押款 7 天。

individual.en: your full legal name and a physical address
individual.zh: 法定全名和实际住址

individual.en: a PayPal account (from mainland China) or a local bank account
individual.zh: PayPal 账户（中国大陆）或本地银行账户

company.en: registration documents and the company tax ID
company.zh: 公司注册文件和税号

company.en: a business bank account in the country of registration
company.zh: 注册国家的对公银行账户

facts.en: Incorporating online costs HK$1,545; the business registration fee and levy are paid with it (HK$2,350 for one year from 1 April 2026), so about HK$3,895 in all.
facts.zh: 网上注册 1,545 港元，商业登记费和征费同时交（2026 年 4 月 1 日起一年 2,350 港元），合计约 3,895 港元。

facts.en: Non-residents may incorporate; the registered office must be in Hong Kong.
facts.zh: 非香港居民也可以注册；注册地址必须在香港。

facts.en: At least one director who is a natural person (need not live in Hong Kong) and a company secretary who lives in Hong Kong or is a Hong Kong company; a sole director cannot also be the secretary.
facts.zh: 至少一名自然人董事（可以不住香港），加一名公司秘书（个人须常住香港，或是香港公司）；唯一的董事不能兼任秘书。

facts.en: No minimum paid-up capital; electronic certificates are normally issued within an hour.
facts.zh: 没有最低实缴资本；电子证书通常一小时内发出。

name.en: A US company through Stripe Atlas
name.zh: 用 Stripe Atlas 注册美国公司

facts.en: US$500 once, including Delaware fees and the first year of the registered agent; the agent is US$100 a year after that.
facts.zh: 一次性 500 美元，含特拉华州政府费和第一年注册代理；之后注册代理每年 100 美元。

facts.en: A Delaware C corporation or LLC; Atlas gets the EIN, which takes 10–35 business days for a founder without an SSN.
facts.zh: 可以选特拉华 C 类公司或 LLC；Atlas 代办 EIN，没有 SSN 的创始人要 10–35 个工作日。

facts.en: US card payments and payouts (up to US$100,000) can start before the EIN arrives; a franchise tax report is due every year by 1 March.
facts.zh: EIN 下来之前就能开通美国卡收款和出款（最多 10 万美元）；每年 3 月 1 日前要交特拉华特许税报告。

facts.en: Atlas does not guarantee approval for Stripe payments.
facts.zh: Atlas 不保证 Stripe 收款一定通过审核。

facts.en: Registering online with Companies House costs £100 and usually takes 24 hours (by post: £124, 8–10 days).
facts.zh: 在 Companies House 网上注册 100 英镑，通常 24 小时内完成（邮寄 124 英镑，8–10 天）。

facts.en: At least one director aged 16 or over, who need not live in the UK; a UK registered office address is required, and a PO box is not accepted.
facts.zh: 至少一名 16 岁以上的董事，可以不住英国；必须有英国注册地址，不能用邮政信箱。

facts.en: Directors verify their identity through GOV.UK One Login; the people with significant control (over 25% of shares or votes, for example) are named at registration. No company secretary is needed.
facts.zh: 董事要通过 GOV.UK One Login 验证身份；注册时要申报重大控制人（比如持股或投票权超过 25%）。不需要公司秘书。
